verdict.rationale: BVNK exposes a rules-based automation API (e.g., POST /payment/v1/rules to auto-link fiat virtual accounts to crypto addresses) and webhooks for real-time automated notifications, plus automatic on-ramp/settlement flows, which together enable background, event-driven automations without manual triggering. However this is payment-domain automation (rules, webhooks) rather than a general agentic/background-task framework, and there's no documentation of scheduling, monitoring dashboards, or broader autonomous workflow orchestration beyond these payment rules. missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling/orchestration beyond payment rules, evidence of monitoring/alerting for autonomous runs, and independent confirmation of reliability of these automations running unattended.
